title: Sunny Sunday, bikes gone
liner_notes: Sixty-one and clear on a weekend morning, and the Nassau dock was empty before we even finished the first coffee. Everyone's out, so we're playing for the ones who stayed in: bright, unhurried, a little nosy.
Sunset comes early now. We let the set wander until then.
